newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Dec inflation 3.0 pct, 103.2 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Dec inflation 3.0 pct, 103.2 pct in '96.

text.p: Venezuela's inflation rate in December was 3.0 percent, slightly down from 3.1 in November, and took inflation over the whole of 1996 to a record 103.2 percent, the Central Bank said.
December's rate was down from 6.0 percent in December 1995 when inflation closed the year at 56.6 percent.
The figure for 1996 was in line with Central Bank president Antonio Casas Gonzalez's annual review published last week. He mentioned a figure of 103 percent.
It was, however, higher than Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar's most recent prediction a month ago of an inflation rate that would not exceed 95 percent for 1996.
December's rate nevertheless showed the same slowing trend in prices rises seen in the second half of the year.
Venezuela launched an IMF-supported economic reform program in mid-April that saw inflation peak at 12.6 percent in May, then drop steadily afterwards.
